failureTypes.name: HTTP 500
failureTypes.description: Upstream internal server crash or unhandled exception response

failureTypes.name: HTTP 429
failureTypes.description: Rate quota exceeded; upstream rejects requests with 429 Too Many Requests

failureTypes.name: TIMEOUT
failureTypes.description: Upstream socket timeout or gateway response deadline exceeded (>30s)

failureTypes.name: HIGH LATENCY
failureTypes.description: Extreme roundtrip response latency spike (>5000ms), exhausting client connection pool

failureTypes.name: SCHEMA MISMATCH
failureTypes.description: Upstream returns unannounced payload schema drift or missing mandatory JSON keys

mitigations.name: Fallback Secondary Provider
mitigations.strategy: Circuit trip and switch to secondary redundant gateway
mitigations.description: Automatically route payment requests through secondary backup provider when primary returns consecutive 500s.

mitigations.name: Retry with Exponential Backoff & Jitter
mitigations.strategy: Exponential backoff retry with full jitter
mitigations.description: Retry transient 500 failures 3 times with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms) and random jitter.

mitigations.name: Dead Letter Queue & Asynchronous Retry
mitigations.strategy: Buffer failed requests into durable queue
mitigations.description: Safely buffer failed requests into durable message queue for delayed idempotent replay.

mitigations.name: Retry-After Honor & Client Token Bucket
mitigations.strategy: Honor upstream Retry-After and throttle client emission
mitigations.description: Inspect HTTP Retry-After response header and throttle outbound request rate via local token bucket.

mitigations.name: Asynchronous Batch Request Queue
mitigations.description: Hold non-urgent requests in queue and smooth out burst spikes below provider rate threshold.

mitigations.name: Strict Timeout SLA & Circuit Breaker
mitigations.description: Clamp socket timeout to 1500ms. If 3 timeouts occur in 10s, trip circuit breaker and return cached/fallback response.

mitigations.name: Asynchronous Degraded Mode
mitigations.strategy: Acknowledge receipt immediately and process asynchronously
mitigations.description: Return optimistic HTTP 202 Accepted to user client and dispatch work to asynchronous background job.

mitigations.name: Stale-While-Revalidate Cache Layer
mitigations.strategy: Serve cached responses to decouple latency
mitigations.description: Immediately return cached data with background asynchronous refresh, isolating upstream latency spikes.

mitigations.name: Latency Cap with Graceful Degradation
mitigations.strategy: Hard 800ms latency ceiling with fallback default
mitigations.description: Enforce strict 800ms ceiling. Return graceful default values or cached fallbacks if upstream exceeds threshold.

mitigations.name: Tolerant Reader & Schema Adapter Layer
mitigations.strategy: Apply defensive parsing and default missing fields
mitigations.description: Parse payload with tolerant reader pattern. Discard unmapped fields and inject default schema values for missing keys.

mitigations.name: API Version Header Fallback
mitigations.strategy: Downgrade API version header to stable contract
mitigations.description: Automatically negotiate previous stable API version header (e.g. 2024-03-01) on payload deserialization error.
